title: Conformal stress improvement in the finite-scaling-support operational framework
exact_target: For four-dimensional operational quantum field theories satisfying all source framework assumptions, including algebraic direct-sum decomposition and finite scaling support for every original field, must the dimension-three virial divergence equal Box L for a physical Hermitian scalar L of dimension two, allowing a symmetric conserved traceless stress improvement with unchanged translation and Lorentz Ward charges and unbroken local conformal Ward identities?
